Header.experienceNextGen: Experience the next generation of enterprise resource planning.

Hero.scaling: Now scaling with new Enterprise Features
Hero.sub: Don't use software that doesn't fit your needs. We build the POS and ERP system to match exactly how you work. You only pay after you test and approve it.

Modules.everything: Everything you need to run your business.
Modules.stopUsing: Stop using many different apps. Our software connects your store, online shop, and back office automatically.
Modules.beautifulPos: A beautiful, easy-to-use touch screen POS. Choose from two different sales screens that fit your working style.
Modules.manageSuppliers: Manage all your suppliers and track your stock perfectly, across as many branches as you need.
Modules.noManual: No more manual typing. Every sale and purchase automatically saves to your accounts with perfect accuracy.
Modules.keepCustomers: Keep your customers coming back. Manage their details and send them automatic SMS and email messages easily.
Modules.dataSafe: Your business data is 100% safe. The system also sends you smart alerts for important events.

BusinessTypes.manageAllBranches: Manage all your branches from one place.
BusinessTypes.retailDesc: Fast barcode scanning, track items with expiry dates, and manage complex pricing rules for wholesale customers.
BusinessTypes.manufacturingDesc: Track raw materials, build product recipes, and manage production costs accurately.
BusinessTypes.supermarketDesc: Handle thousands of items easily. Supports weighing scales and fast checkout lanes.

SyncAddons.neverSell: Never sell an item you don't have. When you sell something in your shop, your website stock updates instantly. When someone buys online, your POS records it and updates your accounts.

SetupProcess.weMakeItEasy: We make it easy to start using our software.
SetupProcess.step1Desc: We will listen to how your business works and understand your exact requirements.
SetupProcess.step2Desc: Our team will configure the software and create your custom system.
SetupProcess.step3Desc: You test the system. If you are happy with it, you pay. If not, you pay nothing.

FAQSection.findAnswers: Find answers to the most common questions about our system.
FAQSection.q1: Do I have to pay before using the software?
FAQSection.a1: No. You only pay after we build the system and you test it. If it does not work for your business, you do not pay.
FAQSection.q2: Can I use it offline if the internet disconnects?
FAQSection.a2: Yes. The system works perfectly offline. When your internet reconnects, it automatically updates the cloud without losing any sales.
FAQSection.q3: Do you provide hardware like printers and barcode scanners?
FAQSection.a3: We provide the software, but it works with almost all standard POS hardware. We can guide you on what to buy or work with your existing equipment.
FAQSection.a4: Yes. You can manage as many branches as you need from a single dashboard. You can check stock and sales for any branch in real-time.
